card.name: Spots where 'checked' is expected next
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'checked' or checkbox term, mostly in software or web-page text about buttons, check boxes and tick boxes. Also fires on a few odd spots such as quote marks in HTML and 'if' in label warnings.

modes.label: Buttons and check boxes
modes.description: Words around a GUI button, check box or tick box where a checked state could follow.
modes.example: by clicking the<< check>> box in the top left corner

modes.label: HTML attribute text
modes.description: Quote or bracket marks inside HTML form markup.

modes.label: Label instructions
modes.description: Words like 'if' in a seal-check warning on drug labels.
modes.example: Do not use<< if>> tamper evident seal is broken or missing

card.writes: It lowers the odds of checked-state words like 'checked' and 'isChecked' as the next word.
card.plain: It marks places in interface or web-form text where a word like 'checked' might come next.
evidence: by clicking the<< check>> box in the top left corner
